pages.text: $(bold)Mana Pedestal$(): the $(bold)only$() way to charge an Elder Crystal.$(br2)$(li)Right-click the pedestal while holding an $(bold)Elder Crystal$() to place it$(li)$(bold)Automation ready$(): hoppers / pipes / other mods can place a crystal on it and take the charged one back, from $(bold)any side$()$(li)$(bold)Automation only takes it once it is full$() (1000 for a crystal, 4000 for a block) - until then it simply stays there charging; $(bold)manual right-click is never limited$() by this$(li)The pedestal is a $(bold)two-block-tall$() structure: the tile where the crystal floats counts as part of it, so hoppers / pipes can connect to $(bold)that tile$() (or to the pedestal itself) and still insert or take - that tile stays invisible with no collision box, exactly as before$(li)Whenever the pedestal holds one, $(bold)right-click takes it back$() (EE included) - $(bold)no empty hand and no sneaking needed$(), whatever you happen to be holding$(li)$(italic)If the pedestal is empty and you are not holding a crystal, the click does nothing at all; and while the pedestal is occupied, placing a second crystal is impossible anyway, so that right-click can only mean "take" - hence no precondition is needed$()$(li)Elder Crystal $(bold)blocks above / below / beside$() the pedestal are charged as well (4000 EE each; the crystal on the pedestal is filled first)$(br2)$(italic)Crafting: echo shard on top; Elder Crystal + Rlyeh Call + Elder Crystal in the middle; deepslate x3 at the bottom (next page).$()

pages.title: Charging rule: darker is faster
pages.text: $(bold)The darker it is, the faster it charges.$()$(br2)One formula only:$(br2)$(bold)rate = full speed x (light cap - light above the pedestal) / light cap$()$(br2)$(li)$(bold)light$() = block light + sky light combined into a single 0..15 value (the very same number vanilla uses for mob spawning)$(li)$(bold)light 0$() gives full speed: $(bold)0.5 EE/s$() by default (= 30 EE per minute, so a 1000 EE crystal takes about $(bold)33 minutes$())$(li)$(bold)light >= 15$() gives $(bold)no charging at all$() (default settings)$(li)Examples: light 12 => 0.1 EE/s; light 14 => 0.033 EE/s$(br2)$(bold)Consequences$() (no extra rules to memorise): a night outdoors is dark, so it is fast; daylight outdoors does not charge; a $(bold)pitch black cave charges at full speed even at noon$(); there is deliberately $(bold)no$() "must be night" or "must see the sky" condition.$(br2)$(italic)Caveat: crystal blocks $(bold)glow$() (light level 7), so stacking them right against the pedestal slows charging a little.$(br2)$(italic)This is only ONE of five sources - the other four are on the next page.$()

pages.title: Five sources, added up
pages.text: $(bold)Every second the pedestal sums what every enabled source offers$() and pours it into the crystal - four sources running in parallel, none of them interfering, with $(bold)no global cap$().$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Light$() (cap $(bold)0.5 EE/s$() by default): darker is faster, see the previous page $(li)$(bold)Plants$(): sphere r=5; every plant inside gains $(bold)+1 wither point per second$() and $(bold)1 point = 0.5 EE$() => 0.5 EE/s each. Caps: $(bold)grass 5 / flower 20 / sapling 30$() points, and the plant $(bold)vanishes$() the second it reaches its cap (total 2.5 / 10 / 15 EE). $(bold)Crops count as flowers$() (cap 20); $(bold)wither roses are excluded$(); wither points live $(bold)in memory$() (reset on restart)$(li)$(bold)Tinker fuel$(): every Tinker fluid container within 5 blocks is $(bold)simulated once per second$() using Tinker's own fuel table (lava / blazing blood / ...) => $(bold)0.5 EE per item$() worth, and the fuel is $(bold)really drained$()$(li)$(bold)Soul death$(): $(bold)any$() living entity dying within 5 blocks ($(bold)players included$()) banks $(bold)EE = max health / 40$() (20 HP = 0.5 EE; a 300 HP wither = 7.5 EE)$(li)$(bold)Demigod presence$(): every player within 5 blocks gives 0.5 EE/s, $(bold)stacking$() with no cost at all (the player feels nothing)$(br2)$(italic)The enabled list lives in $(bold)pedestal_source$() (default $(bold)*$() = all of them; a comma list such as $(italic)light_level,plant$() also works).$()

pages.title: Config keys
pages.text: In $(italic)config/mofengbaizhi/tinkersnewlife-common.toml$(), section $(bold)[elder_crystal]$() (one switch plus own numbers per source):$(br2)$(li)$(bold)pedestal_source$(): which sources are enabled (default $(bold)*$() = all; a comma list also works; $(italic)an old single-id config keeps enabling exactly that one source$())$(li)$(bold)light_enabled$() / $(bold)pedestal_charge_max_per_second$() ($(bold)0.5$()) / $(bold)pedestal_light_cap$() ($(bold)15$())$(li)$(bold)plant_enabled$() / $(bold)plant_radius$() ($(bold)5$()) / $(bold)plant_ee_per_point$() ($(bold)0.5$())$(li)$(bold)fuel_enabled$() / $(bold)fuel_radius$() ($(bold)5$()) / $(bold)fuel_ee_per_item$() ($(bold)0.5$()) / $(bold)fuel_ticks_per_item$() ($(bold)10$())$(li)$(bold)soul_enabled$() / $(bold)soul_radius$() ($(bold)5$()) / $(bold)soul_ee_per_hp$() ($(bold)0.025$() = 20 HP per 0.5 EE)$(li)$(bold)player_enabled$() / $(bold)player_radius$() ($(bold)5$()) / $(bold)player_ee_per_second$() ($(bold)0.5$())$(li)$(bold)pedestal_particles$() / $(bold)pedestal_sound$(): cold particles / a soft chime while charging$(br2)Charging stops when everything is full: a crystal item holds $(bold)1000$() EE, a crystal block $(bold)4000$() - and once full $(bold)no source is queried at all$(), so no fuel is burned and no plant is withered for nothing.

pages.title: Other energy sources later
pages.text: The $(bold)energy conversion system$() (turning another mod's mana/energy into EE) is still $(bold)not$() part of this release - but the interface went from "pick one" to $(bold)many in parallel$():$(br2)$(li)A source is a $(bold)pluggable piece of logic$() implementing $(italic)AmbientEnergySource$() ("how much EE per second can this position give me?", and it tells apart "just ask" from "really settle")$(li)The registry $(italic)AmbientEnergySources$() calls every registered source and $(bold)adds them all up$() (no global cap)$(li)The pedestal block and its block entity know $(bold)nothing$() about light, plants, fluids or souls - once per second they just ask the registry for one total$(br2)=> to hook up another source later: write a new implementation, register one line in $(italic)AmbientEnergySources$(), and add its id to $(bold)pedestal_source$(). $(bold)No block changes needed$().$(br2)$(italic)Cross-system conversion (mana / souls / curse <-> EE) always goes through $(bold)EnergyUnits$(), the single conversion table.$()
